The only dark lines are the smooth pointiness-based contour in the folds and the thin curved emissive cracks at the foot; the 002 Voronoi slashes are gone. Remaining caveats: the painted tiles repeat visibly on the 2048 backdrop atlas at close range (they are meant for 20-40 m), and the smooth shading shows soft gradients across the larger facets near sharp folds.
